changelog: Fix: a real Position History paste failed with 'more than one unrecognized line', naming the exit-reason line and Realized PnL% together -- Realized PnL% wasn't matching its own entry in the known-label set despite being in it. Cause: PHP's trim() does not strip a non-breaking space (U+00A0), which a browser copy of a styled card can carry trailing a label; 'realized pnl% ' (with the stray space) no longer equals the 'realized pnl%' map key, so the line fell through to the exit-reason leftover slot and collided with the real exit reason. Added bf_clean_line() -- collapses U+00A0, U+200B (zero-width space), and U+FEFF (BOM/zero-width-no-break-space) to a plain space, then collapses whitespace runs and trims -- applied to every Position History line and, via bf_split_line(), every Transaction History cell

Verify: label matching was and remains a single exact-string hashmap lookup, never a prefix or substring check -- 'Realized PnL' cannot cross-match 'Realized PnL%' regardless of scan order. Self-test extended with a block that places Realized PnL% before Realized PnL (catching a prefix bug in either direction) and a copy of it with a literal U+00A0 appended to the Realized PnL% line (reproducing the live failure exactly) -- both assert pnl lands on -98.68, never -10.10
